rationale: The branch review read all changed files, all gates are green, and no findings or deferred minors are open. In session-tool-support.ts, allowedTools only removes a profile's built-in tools, always keeps the scratchpad tools, and grants and ask rules come from the narrowed list. native-backend.ts passes the provider filter (providerAdmits) only when allowedTools is set. subagent-runs.ts records the owning nested session before handling an ask, adds only turn_end to takeCost, forwards only tool_call/tool_result, never gives the nested session the agents provider, and removes the abort listener in finally. The extra settle() method serves US-010's rule that the nested session closes before the parent send settles. No concrete problem found.

The CI repair that was not re-reviewed (ece6056a1) changes only packages/nax/test/unit/session/manager.test.ts. It fixes a timing flake: the test reset the clock to real time before creating the 'recent' session, then swept with a 1 ms limit, so a few milliseconds of runtime could evict it. Both clocks now stay pinned to FAKE_NOW_MS, giving ages of exactly 10000 ms and 0 ms, so sweepOrphans(1) deterministically returns 1. No source code changed. The rest of the branch was spot-checked in the earlier ruling: the allowedTools narrowing, the providerAdmits wiring, and subagent-runs ask ownership, cost and event routing. Minor and not blocking: nowMs is restored at the end of the test body rather than in a finally block, the same as before the fix.
